title: Sum and intersection identity for Tate residues
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, $C$ a commutative $k$-algebra, and $V$ a $C$-module. Let $A,B\subseteq V$ be $k$-subspaces such that $(fA+A)/A$ and $(fB+B)/B$ are finite-dimensional over $k$ for every $f\in C$. Then $A+B$ and $A\cap B$ have the same admissibility property. For the $k$-linear abstract residues $\operatorname{res}_{V,L}:\Omega^1_{C/k}\to k$ of [lem-pc-tate-abstract-residue-calculus], one has
$$\operatorname{res}_{V,A}+\operatorname{res}_{V,B}=\operatorname{res}_{V,A+B}+\operatorname{res}_{V,A\cap B}.$$
